messages:
rachel: Quick Q — compliance asked to extend SIEM export retention for a set of eDiscovery cases from 90d -> 13 months. Thinking: change S3 lifecycle + keep KMS-wrapped backups. Any RBAC/KMS gotchas for exports to EU copy?
alex: Important — if we export copies into eu-west, KMS key policies need explicit region principals. Also watch cross-account key grants.
zach: +1. Also note GDPR DSARs: storing longer in eu region is fine but we need delete hooks tied to DSAR. Who owns deletion automation?
jamie: For RBAC I'd prefer scoped roles rather than broad "siem-admin". Propose creating a 'siem-exporter' role with just PutObject + kms:Encrypt on dedicated key. Use OPA to gate who can request export.
alex: Agree. Also rotate KMS key schedule — if key rotates, old objects remain decryptable via key rotation policy, but re-encryption not automatic. We should add a rewrap job.
rachel: Good point. Would rewrap require downtime?
zach: No downtime, but rewrap is IO-heavy. We should schedule rate-limited job, and talk to infra for throughput.
jamie: To capture approval flow: request -> legal review -> OPA policy check -> ticket created -> infra runs export job. Can we embed the approval chain in the export metadata so audits can prove consent?
logbot: ticket #SEC-4821 created by rachel for "SIEM export retention extn (13mo) + RBAC/KMS plan" — assign: alex, jamie.
alex: Also: add audit fields to exported objects: export_id, requester, approver, legal_case_id, retention_expiry. Put metadata in S3 object tags + Dynamo index for quick lookup.
rachel: For retention enforcement: lifecycle rule + S3 Object Lock (governance mode?) Thoughts?
jamie: Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) is heavyweight, needs account-level configs. Lifecycle + periodic enforcement + tag-based deletes should be fine. But for legal hold we should support Object Lock.
zach: Security note: make sure SIEM forwarders don't leak original tenant IDs in metadata for exports. Redact PII before export where possible.
rachel: Next steps: alex + jamie to draft RBAC policy + KMS key policy; zach to scope rewrap job; i'll update ticket with timeline. Thanks :thumbsup:
